## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix the missing `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` default before merge so CI can configure exclusions through the environment.

## Changes

The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that matches file basenames and logs skipped paths. It documents the flag and adds tests for argument parsing, file collection, and archive contents.

## Critical

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude` argument, the archive still includes `build.log`. The hardcoded `[]` breaks `.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11`: “Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that configure exclusions through the environment produce archives containing files they intended to omit.

## Suggestions

- cli/main.py:33 — tests — Test a literal exclusion against a nested basename — An invocation with `--exclude skip.log` and a file at `logs/skip.log` has no coverage. Every matching test uses a leading `*`, which would also match if the code passed the whole path to `fnmatch`. — A regression that matches whole paths could leave nested files in archives despite an explicit basename exclusion.
